name: Lean MVP Squad
description: Small cross-functional team for a fast, single-workload MVP build.

roles.description: Owns architecture, code reviews, and technical decisions.
Builds UI, API, and data layer features end to end.
Writes and runs test plans, manages regression suite.
Prioritises backlog and validates delivered increments.

name: Enterprise Integration Team
description: Mid-size delivery team for an enterprise system integration with governance overhead.

roles.description: Defines target architecture, integration patterns, and non-functional requirements.
Runs delivery cadence, risk log, and stakeholder reporting.
Builds services, integrations, and data pipelines.
Implements UI components and client-side integration.
Manages test strategy, automation, and UAT support.
Sets up CI/CD pipelines, environments, and monitoring.

name: AI Platform Build Team
description: Specialist team for building an AI/agentic platform with data engineering needs.

roles.description: Designs agent orchestration, model selection, and platform architecture.
Implements prompt engineering, agent workflows, and model integration.
Builds ingestion pipelines and data stores for grounding and telemetry.
Builds the platform UI and API surface.
Validates functional and responsible-AI test scenarios.
Coordinates delivery across engineering and data teams.

name: APAC Regional Delivery Team
description: Regional team structure priced in AUD for local delivery engagements.

roles.description: Owns delivery plan, client communication, and quality bar.
Leads feature build and mentors junior developers.
Implements features and fixes defects.
Executes test cases and reports defects.
